cycle.label: Licensure cycle
cycle.note: Utah licenses and CPE run January 1 of an odd year to December 31 of the even year: 80 hours, including 4 ethics (1 on Utah law and rules). No yearly minimum.

requirements.label: Total CPE
requirements.note: 80 hours each two-year cycle (R156-26a-303b). Up to 40 extra hours carry forward as general CPE.

requirements.label: Ethics
requirements.note: 4 hours of ethics each cycle, including the 1-hour Utah laws and rules course.

requirements.label: Utah laws & rules
requirements.note: 1 hour on Utah's CPA Licensing Act and Board rules. We count courses with "Utah" and "laws", "rules" or "ethics" in the title.

newLicensee.note: No CPE is required at your first renewal after initial licensure.

licenseDateHint: Utah licenses expire December 31 of even-numbered years (e.g. 12/31/2026).
issueDateHint: If you were first licensed this cycle, no CPE is due at your first renewal.
limitsNotTracked: The current rule has no caps on self-study, nano or instruction (some older summaries still list them).
recordRetention: Keep CPE certificates; reporting goes through NASBA's CPE Audit Service.
toVerify: Record retention period isn't stated in the current rule.
